The vector a is shown in the diagram below. Draw the vectors 2a and −3a.

First, notice that both 2a and −3a must be parallel to a.

Now, for the vector 2a we have the following:

  • The magnitude of 2a is 2 times the magnitude of a.
  • Vectors a and 2a have the same direction since the factor 2 is positive.

Next, for the vector −3a we have the following:

  • The magnitude of 3a is 3 times the magnitude of a.
  • Vectors a and −3a have opposite directions since the factor −3 is negative.
